title: What a Samurai vs. Mongol Battle Really Looked Like
author: History Dose
shortDescription:
The clash of two legendary and feared classes of warrior: the Mongols and the samurai. They meet on the beaches of Tsushima. What did combat between them look like? Today, we look at the fascinating warfare that characterized the first and second Mongol invasions.
